input_root_2026_11_15.abi: Existing internal message numbers and driver ABI remain unchanged; new private messages are appended. IMM32 public ABI is unchanged.
input_root_2026_11_15.cross_process_root: The native XIC belongs to the outer Qt root thread, but the focused mail CEF child belongs to another process. Per-process IMM update IDs and the old character bridge cannot deliver composition/caret state to that child.
input_root_2026_11_15.cross_process_fix: Pointer-free UTF-16 async payload to the exact foreign focus within the same GA_ROOT, receiver validation/stale-focus checks and owner-thread XIC spot positioning; focus activation runs in the destination process.
input_root_2026_11_15.cef_root: CEF107 defaults to TSF and ignores the IMM composition path. Select its supported IMM32 backend through --disable-features=TSFImeSupport; do not inject committed WM_CHAR or change Windows version.
input_root_2026_11_15.reset_root: Completion, cancellation and ImeSetActiveContext(FALSE) previously ended only Windows-side composition. Each native XIC now owns its own buffer/cursor/reset state, with referenced lifetime during reset/focus and detached ownership before destruction. Reset inactive roots too. New native focus with no owned Windows composition rejects preedit inherited from another XIC; own preedit and non-callback styles retain their behavior.
input_root_2026_11_15.buffered_event_root: Synchronous Xlib calls can leave native events in Xlib after the fd is drained. Full message pumps check that queue and final flush re-drains it before acknowledging the driver as empty.
input_root_2026_11_15.buffered_event_negative: ime-queue-negative/result.json records queue_stall_reproduced, not an overall positive test.
